टक्किराज: Ṭakkirāja, n. of a Buddhist deity (one of the krodha): Sādh 137.10 et al. Also Acalaṭak°, Acaraṭarkirāja, qq.v.
टङ्गणक्षार: ṭaṅgaṇa-kṣāra, m. (= Skt. ṭaṅkaṇa-kṣāra and Lex. ṭaṅgaṇa), borax: Mvy 5903.
टिटिभ: ṭiṭibha, m. (cf. ṭiṭila, tiṭilambha), a high number: Mvy 8016. Tib. mthaḥ (= Skt. anta) snaṅ (light, bright-ness; thinking of Skt. bhā ?).
टिटिल: ṭiṭila, nt., a high number: °lam Mvy 7964, cited from LV 148.3 where tiṭilambha, q.v. Tib. as on LV, confirming -lambha as last part of the word.
टिप्पिटक: ṭippiṭaka, m. (unrecorded; cf. Skt. ṭippaṇī etc.?), acc. to Tib. mdor bśad pa, condensed explanation, or, sa bcad (gcad) pa, synopsis: Mvy 1448.
टिव्यक: ṭivyaka, m., Mvy 9416, Chin. snapping the fingers in water, and fig. a moment, jiffy; Tib. has a long phrase the first part of which means snapping the fingers in water; the rest is obscure to me: chu la ḥdzub (mdzub) mos se gol rdob rkus ḥdzugs pa ḥgal gzugs ḥkhri las ḥdzugs pa.
टेराक्ष: ṭerākṣa, adj. (= Skt. Lex. ṭeraka; v.l. torakṣa, Mironov ṭorakṣa), squint-eyed: Mvy 8882 = Tib. mig noṅ ba (faulty eye); Chin. having eyes with deep sockets.
